invariants.description: Selection is deterministic for identical registry state and request
Disabled providers are never selected
Incompatible providers are never selected
Providers missing mandatory capabilities are never selected
Assertion fallback never converts UNSUPPORTED into SUPPORTED
Assertion fallback never converts INDETERMINATE into SUPPORTED without new evidence
Action fallback never converts DENIED into AUTHORIZED
Action fallback never converts substantive INDETERMINATE into AUTHORIZED
Infrastructure failure may trigger fallback only when policy permits
No valid assertion provider results in INDETERMINATE
No valid action provider results in INDETERMINATE and no dispatch
Fallback provider constraints and obligations are fully enforced
Fallback use is visible in audit and trace records
Providers of the same family never import one another
Assertion providers never import action providers
Action providers never import assertion providers
Registry selection never depends on native provider result types
Provider result types do not leak across provider boundaries
Health degradation alone does not bypass capability requirements
No fallback policy authorizes fail-open behavior
